pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato channassa upaṭṭhāko mahāmatto āyasmato channassa vihāraṃ kārāpeti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:1.3: athakho āyasmā channo katapariyositaṃ vihāraṃ punappunaṃ chādāpesi punappunaṃ limpāpesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:1.5: athakho āyasmā channo tiṇañca kaṭṭhañca saṅkaḍḍhanto aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa yavakhettaṃ dūsesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:1.6: athakho so brāhmaṇo ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma bhaddantā amhākaṃ yavakhettaṃ dūsessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:1.8: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa brāhmaṇassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:1.9: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:1.10: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā channo katapariyositaṃ vihāraṃ punappunaṃ chādāpessati punappunaṃ limpāpessati atibhāriko vihāro paripatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:1.11: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:1.12: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ channa katapariyositaṃ vihāraṃ punappunaṃ chādāpesi punappunaṃ limpāpesi atibhāriko vihāro paripatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:1.15: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa katapariyositaṃ vihāraṃ punappunaṃ chādāpessasi punappunaṃ limpāpessasi atibhāriko vihāro paripati
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:1.17: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:1.18.1: mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena yāva dvārakosā aggaḷaṭṭhapanāya ālokasandhiparikammāya dvitticchadanassa pariyāyaṃ apharite ṭhitena adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ tato ce uttariṃ apharitepi ṭhito adhiṭṭhaheyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:2.1.4: ullitto vā hoti avalitto vā ullittāvalitto vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:2.1.12: vātapānaparikammāya setavaṇṇaṃ kāḷavaṇṇaṃ gerukavaṇṇaṃ mālākammaṃ latākammaṃ makaradantakaṃ pañcapaṭṭhikaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:2.1.15: sace harite ṭhito adhiṭṭhāti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:2.1.16: maggena chādentassa dve magge adhiṭṭhahitvā tatiyaṃ maggaṃ āṇāpetvā pakkamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:2.1.17: pariyāyena chādentassa dve pariyāye adhiṭṭhahitvā tatiyaṃ pariyāyaṃ āṇāpetvā pakkamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:2.1.18: tato ce uttariṃ apharitepi ṭhito adhiṭṭhaheyyāti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:2.1.20: silāya chādentassa silāya silāya āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:2.1.21: sudhāya chādentassa piṇḍe piṇḍe āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:2.1.22: tiṇena chādentassa karaḷe karaḷe āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc19:2.1.23: paṇṇena chādentassa paṇṇe paṇṇe āpatti pācittiyassa.
